name: Kaido
title: Ramp up your DON!! cards and spend them all at once with this high-power, high-cost deck!
desc: A ramp deck that focuses on building DON!! cards with "Onigashima Island" to get high-cost cards out faster than your opponent. Sacrifice DON!! cards to overwhelm your opponent with cards carrying powerful effects.

cards.name: Kaido
cards.text: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] DON!! −7 (You may return the specified number of DON!! cards from your field to your DON!! deck.): Trash up to 1 of your opponent's Life cards.
